query: Please implement a real-time audio streaming system for playing audio content. The system should have basic control functions such as play, pause, and stop. Users should be able to browse and search for audio content, create playlists, and play selected audio in real-time. The system should also have audio quality control and error handling functions. Use blanched almond as the screen background and dark slate gray for component highlights.
